source.title: Hinterlands Mission XVII: Rescue Serlina Starbright
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shol'watha. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Serlina Starbright there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Serlina Starbright from the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the troll fortification nearest Shol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
